questions.cardText:
[Economics] Which of the following is NOT considered one of the Four Asian Tigers?
A. South Korea
B. Singapore
C. Malaysia
Answer: C. The Four Asian Tigers, also known as the Asian Dragons, refer to the highly developed economies of Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea, and Taiwan. These regions experienced rapid industrialization and economic growth from the 1960s to the 1990s, transforming into advanced high-income economies.
questions.en: Hong Kong, Singapore and South Korea are three of the Four Asian Tigers, which industrialised rapidly from the 1960s to the 1990s. Which economy is the fourth?
questions.de: Hongkong, Singapur und Südkorea sind drei der vier „Tigerstaaten“, die sich von den 1960er- bis zu den 1990er-Jahren rasant industrialisierten. Welche Volkswirtschaft ist die vierte?

timeline.labelEn: Rapid industrialisation and growth of the Four Asian Tigers (Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan)
timeline.labelDe: Rasante Industrialisierung und Wachstum der vier Tigerstaaten (Hongkong, Singapur, Südkorea, Taiwan)

questions.notes: A 'which is NOT' question (answer Malaysia); asked the positive fact instead — the missing fourth Tiger.

questions.cardText:
[Agronomy] Where was the watermelon originally from?
A. Africa
B. South America
C. Asia
Answer: A. Watermelon cultivation dates back to ancient Egypt, as archaeological evidence and tomb offering depictions suggest.
questions.en: On which continent did the watermelon originate, being domesticated there and grown in ancient Egypt?
questions.de: Auf welchem Kontinent stammt die Wassermelone her, wo sie domestiziert und schon im alten Ägypten angebaut wurde?

timeline.labelEn: Watermelons, domesticated in Sudan, are cultivated in Egypt
timeline.labelDe: In Sudan domestizierte Wassermelonen werden in Ägypten angebaut

questions.notes: Card answer correct; Wikipedia is more specific: the modern watermelon was domesticated in Sudan (Kordofan melons are its closest relatives) and grown in Egypt by 2000 BCE.
